sources.title: kingjones777/Muse-Glimmer-30B-ROCmFP4-Strix-Halo-DFlash-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Four ROCmFP4 quantisations of Meta's Muse-Glimmer-30B built for AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S / gfx1151, bundled with the DFlash speculative drafter and vision projector. ROCmFP4 is a runtime tensor format that exists only in the ROCmFPX fork of llama.cpp; Muse Glimmer support exists only in current upstream — this build ports the model forward into the ROCmFPX base so the two can meet.
